story.title: Golu festival of dolls
paragraphs_en: Golu was around the corner, Juhi's mom always arranges all the dolls for golu. This time her mom was out of town, so Juhi wanted to surprise to her mom by arranging the dolls.
Juhi's mom wraps up the golu dolls and toys with paper and stores them in this green box. Her mom also makes a list of toys stored in the box. Juhi got the box out of the store room.
Juhi unwraps the toys very carefully. Look, she found the musical instruments.The veena is the national musical instrument of India. Did you know that?
Juhi found the stainless steel kitchen play set. There is a gas stove also in this kitchen play set. Do you like the kitchen play set?
Juhi asked her grandma to help her to arrange the dolls and toys for golu. Her grandma was glad to help.
Juhi and her grandma started arranging the dolls and toys. Look at the pink set of nesting dolls. Do you like the pink nesting dolls?
Juhi is almost done with arranging the dolls and toys. Every year her mom buys a new toy for golu. Juhi wanted to buy one this year.
Juhi went to the market, she was looking for a doll, but she saw so many other toys, not a doll. She thought of making a doll all by herself.
Juhi bought some clay from the market. She molded the clay and made the doll. She also made made two little birds.
Juhi made a beautiful rangoli in front of the golu, she kept everything ready.
The next day Juhi's mom was back, she was surprised to see everything arranged for golu. She was proud of Juhi.
Juhi and her family were ready to welcome friends to their house to celebrate golu, the fesival of dolls.
Golu is a festival of dolls, celebrated in South India during Navaratri. All the family members join to clean up the house,unpack the dolls and arrange them on the steps.
